Admission
Please see the MS Pharmaceutical Sciences (non-thesis) for general requirements. Students will apply for the program during the Fall semester of the 2nd year (second professional year of PharmD program [P2] by October 1 through the current URI process, and will be notified of acceptance in the Spring of the application year.
Apply Now
To apply:
Have completed a minimum of 75 credits including all PharmD pre-requisite courses and requirements to transfer to the Degree Granting College, with a minimum 3.0 GPA and be in Good Standing within the PharmD program as of September 1 of the 4th year of study (second professional year (P2)).
Be enrolled in all PharmD required courses for the P2 Fall (BPS 437, PHP 427, PHC415, PHP407, PHP/BPS 415, BPS320, PHP450)
Submit a letter of interest from the applicant and a CV/resume
